name: structure
expression: (async()=>{const $=id=>document.getElementById(id);let out=[];if($('start').hidden||!$('start').textContent.includes('后端，是让一件事可靠地完成'))throw Error('backend overview');document.querySelector('[data-nav="principles"]').click();if($('principles').hidden)throw Error('principles nav');document.querySelector('[data-concept-answer="right"]').click();if(!$('concept-feedback').textContent.includes('✓'))throw Error('concept check');for(const [key,code,total,count]of [['success',201,8,3],['auth',401,4,2],['invalid',422,5,2],['forbidden',403,6,2],['quota',409,7,10],['database',503,8,2]]){$('scenario').value=key;$('scenario').dispatchEvent(new Event('change'));let n=1;while(!$('flow-next').disabled&&n<12){$('flow-next').click();n++}if(n!==total)throw Error(key+' steps '+n);if(!$('flow-snapshot').textContent.includes('HTTP '+code))throw Error(key+' status');if(!$('flow-snapshot').textContent.includes('数据库待办总数：'+count))throw Error(key+' mutation');if(key==='database'&&!$('flow-snapshot').textContent.includes('ROLLBACK'))throw Error('rollback missing');out.push(key+' '+code);}document.querySelector('[data-page="architecture"]').click();for(const b of document.querySelectorAll('[data-architecture]')){b.click();if(!$('architecture-purpose').textContent)throw Error('empty layer')}document.querySelector('[data-layer-answer="right"]').click();if(!$('layer-feedback').textContent.includes('✓'))throw Error('layer quiz');$('architecture-to-lab').click();if($('lab').hidden||$('api-guide').hidden)throw Error('architecture to guided lab');document.querySelector('[data-page="toolbox"]').click();document.querySelector('[data-start-track="linux"]').click();if($('cli').hidden)throw Error('toolbox course');if(document.querySelector('[aria-current="page"]').dataset.page!=='toolbox')throw Error('toolbox selection');document.querySelector('[data-page="start"]').click();return out})()
